title: TicTacToe
body:
# 🎮 TicTacToe

A modern, feature-rich and fully configurable TicTacToe minigame for Minecraft servers.

Challenge your friends or play against intelligent AI bots directly inside a beautiful inventory GUI. No arenas, no setup maps, no complicated installations — everything happens inside an interactive menu.

Perfect for Survival, CityBuild, SMP, Lobby and Network servers.

---

## ✨ Features

- ✅ Play against other players
- ✅ Play against AI bots
- ✅ Easy, Medium and Hard bot difficulties
- ✅ Modern inventory GUI
- ✅ Interactive TicTacToe board
- ✅ Challenge system
- ✅ Automatic win detection
- ✅ Automatic draw detection
- ✅ Statistics system
- ✅ Leaderboards
- ✅ Optional Vault support
- ✅ Betting / wager system
- ✅ Reward system
- ✅ Sound effects
- ✅ Fully configurable
- ✅ Lightweight and optimized

---

## 🤖 Bot Difficulties

Choose your challenge level:

- 🟢 Easy
- 🟡 Medium
- 🔴 Hard

Hard mode uses advanced move calculations and can be very challenging to beat.

---

## 🏆 Statistics System

Track your progress with detailed statistics:

- Games Played
- Wins
- Losses
- Draws
- Win Rate
- Current Win Streak
- Highest Win Streak

Use:

```text
/ttt stats
```

---

## 💰 Betting System

Optional Vault integration allows players to wager money against each other.

Examples:

```text
$100 vs $100

$1,000 vs $1,000

$10,000 vs $10,000
```

Winner takes the entire pot.

All limits are configurable.

---

## 🎁 Reward System

Reward players for winning games.

Supported rewards:

- Money
- Items
- Commands
- Permissions

Everything can be customized inside the configuration.

---

## 🎨 GUI System

The entire game takes place inside a custom inventory GUI.

Features:

- Custom GUI titles
- Custom items
- Custom sounds
- Custom layouts
- Custom messages

No arena required.

No world setup required.

---

## ⚙ Fully Configurable

Configure almost everything:

- Messages
- Sounds
- Bot Difficulty Settings
- Rewards
- GUI Items
- GUI Titles
- Betting Limits
- Statistics
- Commands

---

## 📜 Commands

```text
/ttt
/ttt challenge <player>
/ttt bot <easy|medium|hard>
/ttt stats
/ttt top
/ttt reload
```

---

## 🔑 Permissions

```text
tictactoe.play
tictactoe.bot
tictactoe.stats
tictactoe.top
tictactoe.reload
```

---

## 🚀 Perfect For

- Survival Servers
- SMP Servers
- CityBuild Servers
- Lobby Servers
- Network Servers
- Minigame Servers

---

## ❤️ Why TicTacToe?

Unlike many simple TicTacToe plugins, this plugin offers:

- Modern GUI design
- AI opponents
- Betting support
- Statistics
- Leaderboards
- Extensive configuration options

Everything you need for a professional TicTacToe experience.

Enjoy playing! 🎮
